entry.summary:
<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<p><strong>The Service Modernisation Roadmap was decommissioned in June 2026.</strong></p>
<p>Work to ensure government digital services are accessible continues through the <a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/digitising-government-programme-dgp/digital-target-state">Digital Government Target State</a>.</p>
</div>
<h2 id="process-step-nav-title">Contents</h2>
<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/executive-summary-accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand">Executive summary</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/1-overview">1. Overview</a>
<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/1-overview#1-1-goals">1.1 Goals</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/1-overview#1-2-business-values">1.2 Business values</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/1-overview#1-3-process">1.3 Process</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/2-findings">2. Findings</a>
<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/2-findings#2-1-current-state-of-standards-and-practice-within-government">2.1 Current state of standards and practice within government</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/2-findings#2-2-lived-experience-of-disabled-people-interacting-with-government">2.2 Lived experience of disabled people interacting with government</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/2-findings#2-3-gaps-barriers-and-motivations">2.3 Gaps, barriers, and motivations</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/3-recommendations">3. Recommendations</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/4-next-steps">4. Next steps</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/5-research-questions">5. Research questions</a>
<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/5-research-questions#5-1-das-research-questions">5.1 DAS Research questions</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/accessible-digital-government-services-for-new-zealand/5-research-questions#5-2-dsds-research-questions">5.2 DSDS Research questions</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Downloadable ebook</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Accessible-digital-government-services-for-New-Zealand.epub">Accessible Digital Government Services in New Zealand — e-book (EPUB, 661 KB)&nbsp;</a></p>
<h3>About EPUB format</h3>
<p>EPUB is an accessible ebook format that can be read on any device. If you do not have an EPUB reader installed, we recommend <a href="https://www.edrlab.org/software/thorium-reader/">Thorium Reader</a>. It’s an accessible, free, multilingual and multi-format reading application without ads or private data leakage.</p>
<h2>Create a printable PDF copy of the web pages</h2>
<p>While we encourage you to download or read the guide online, we understand that sometimes you may want a printed copy.</p>
<p>On an iOS device: <a href="https://support.apple.com/en-nz/guide/iphone/iphfd5b616b5/ios">Save a web page as a PDF on IOS</a></p>
<p>On Android:</p>
<ol>
<li>In the browser, choose Share. This may be in a menu.</li>
<li>Choose Print.</li>
<li>Choose the option to Save as PDF.</li>
</ol>
<p>On a Windows, macOS or Linux computer:</p>
<ol>
<li>In your browser, press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd> (Windows/Linux) or <kbd>Cmd</kbd>&nbsp;+&nbsp;<kbd>P</kbd> (macOS) to open the print menu.</li>
<li>Look for the ‘Save as PDF’ option. It may be in the Destination or Printer areas.</li>
<li>Choose ‘Save as PDF’ and click Save. You’ll need to give it a name and choose where to save it to.</li>
</ol>
